Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md) — the canonical documentation map. Review domain module documentation before making changes. Use module owners (or the platform team) for approvals when cross-cutting concerns are involved. For architecture changes, capture decisions in `DECISIONS/` using an ADR.

Platform: `crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra. Domains: `crates/rustok-*`. Frontends: `apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`. MCP: `crates/rustok-mcp`. Tooling: `scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. Ownership: [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).

`docs/` is Russian; public-facing contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and crate `README.md` files are English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file. Component docs: `apps/<name>/docs/` or `crates/<name>/docs/`. Every app and crate must have a root `README.md` with: purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, and a link to `docs/`. `docs/modules/_index.md` links to all per-module documentation folders.

For architecture, API, events, modules, tenancy, routing, UI contracts, or observability changes: update local docs, central docs, [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md), and, if added or renamed, [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md); mark outdated documents `deprecated` or `archived` and point to replacements.

Do not create a new document if a suitable one already exists — extend the existing one. Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code. Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures. Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested. Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
